provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added with the lilies work (2026-10-18): every character from the floras in the lilies notes (plantgen-claude project-files/lilies/SOURCES.md), drawn by the rules its taxa hold; drawing values only where no character says them.

taxon.note: WCVP v16 accepted name Lilium bulbiferum, plant_name_id 280683.

growth_form.note: A bulbous herb with one leafy flowering stem a year, drawn by the forb form.

growth.note: Grown five years from seed, as a lily bulb takes three to five to flower; drawn at its third and fifth years.

variants.note: One seed in the open, as the built-in species.

generator.params.note: Its few upright flowers stand close at the stem's tip (Wikipedia: one to five), drawn as a raceme a twenty-fifth of the stem long.

allometry.note: Wikipedia, 'Lilium bulbiferum' (read 2026-10-18): on average 20-90 cm, at most 120 cm; Bailey (p. 1876): stem 2-4 ft. Its reference height is the middle of that range, 0.55 m, at its last keyframe.

traits.height_typical_m.note: Wikipedia, 'Lilium bulbiferum' (read 2026-10-18): on average 20-90 cm, at most 120 cm; Bailey (p. 1876): stem 2-4 ft.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 4 (1916), Lilium bulbiferum, p. 1876 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-18): leaves 50-75, horizontal or semi-erect, with no whorls named: read as scattered.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 4 (1916), Lilium bulbiferum, p. 1876 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-18): leaves 3-4 in long; Wikipedia: up to 10 cm.

traits.leaf_posture.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 4 (1916), Lilium bulbiferum, p. 1876 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-18): leaves horizontal or semi-erect.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Wikipedia, 'Lilium bulbiferum' (read 2026-10-18): the inflorescence has one to five flowers; Bailey: flowers 1-4. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.flower_posture.note: Wikipedia, 'Lilium bulbiferum' (read 2026-10-18): hermaphroditic and scentless, have six upright tepals.

traits.corolla_shape.note: Wikipedia, 'Lilium bulbiferum' (read 2026-10-18): six upright tepals, the outer slightly narrower than the inner.

traits.perianth_reflexion.note: Wikipedia, 'Lilium bulbiferum' (read 2026-10-18): the tepals upright, their tips spreading in the photographs on the page; neither source says they curve back.

traits.flower_colour.note: Wikipedia, 'Lilium bulbiferum' (read 2026-10-18): bright yellow-orange; Bailey: bright orange-red, tinged or blotched yellow in centre. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.perianth_spots.note: Wikipedia, 'Lilium bulbiferum' (read 2026-10-18): with reddish-brown dots; Bailey: spotted deep purplish black.

traits.perianth_spot_colour.note: Wikipedia, 'Lilium bulbiferum' (read 2026-10-18): reddish-brown dots. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.tepal_length_m.note: Wikipedia, 'Lilium bulbiferum' (read 2026-10-18): the flowers 4-6 cm long.

traits.stamen_exsertion.note: Wikipedia, 'Lilium bulbiferum' (read 2026-10-18): the stamens erect, about half as long as the tepals.

traits.anther_colour.note: Wikipedia, 'Lilium bulbiferum' (read 2026-10-18): with red anthers; Bailey: anthers red. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.flowering_months.note: Wikipedia, 'Lilium bulbiferum' (read 2026-10-18): flowering May through July; Bailey: June, early July.
